newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia CPI up 4 pct in first nine months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia CPI up 4 pct in first nine months.

text.p: Tunisia's consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.0 percent during the first nine months of 1996 compared with the same period in 1995, Economic Development Minister Taoufik Baccar said on Tuesday.
He told journalists that the year-on-year rise for the first nine months of 1995 was 6.3 percent.
He did not give other details, saying the National Institute of Statistics will release the figures soon.
Baccar confirmed that forecast for the whole year 1996 would be less than 4.5 percent as annoucned on Saturday by Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali. "It might be 4.0 percent," he said.
The yearly average inflation rate as measured by the CPI was put at 5.0 percent between 1992 and 1996, he added.
